rationale: Conservative OPD recipe on top of a stage-1 adapter where baseline composite (0.807) is at the cap-#5 high-baseline watch zone. Gentle lr, low epochs, samples_per_prompt=1 to minimize the risk of teacher-rollout-quality-asymmetry regressing on the bad-rollout tail.
high_baseline_caveat: Stage-1 composite is 0.807, at the edge of the cap-#5 watch zone (>0.80 with variable rollout quality). Recipe uses lr=5e-5 (half the kiln default 1e-4) and 3 epochs (half the default 6). If first eval regresses by > σ, revert to stage-1 and file a stage-transition dead-end.
